segments.title: the original condition and its world
segments.note: PROVISIONAL machine reconciliation by reused Codex non-author c05_253_255_reconcile. Original producers were primary Codex, Tibetan-first with prior preparation, and reused peer c05_262_264_english, English-first. This is not human editorial acceptance. Dvangs/sweet is omitted as an unresolved lexical mismatch, not nulled or redirected to a distant liquid. The separately preserved sweet-to-clear editorial candidate is refuted under ground (d) and REFUTE's uncertainty default: deliberate contextual paraphrase or another Tibetan source remains possible. The positive clarity/taste evidence leaves the word pair unresolved and does not establish indefensible published English. No current erratum is retained; GMR's sweet, cool water remains verbatim. Full positive dvangs pa/clear and mngar ba/sweet records and C05:251's distinct qualities were checked; empty dvangs ba is not evidence about dvangs pa. The first outer world is selected once; later outer-world/world and liquid references are reprises. First mi'i owns the singular human karma owner and second the plural humans world occupants. Brten nas grub pas/created by is one complete causal phrase. Final de nyid du gnas pa/original condition retains the resumed state relation. The narrower gsum and thun mong ma yin pa lexical units omit distributed inflectional framing. Sogs owns the full lexical closure and so on, with a specific proposed head allowance. Shared physical and digital readings do not establish independent publication lineage or translator intent.
